title: W11296289 — THESEUS/CUDA service mode entry
description: Enter dispenser UI service mode for steps 1–35 (THESEUS ACU).

steps.title: Enter THESEUS service mode
steps.body: First 5 min after power-on: set RC and FC temp to minimum. Hold FREEZER TEMP + ICE TYPE 3 seconds. All LEDs verify, then press all 5 keys left-to-right to turn LEDs off. Use Light (SW2) to advance steps; RC TEMP (SW5) toggles loads.
